environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, TCP passthrough on port 443 with TLS termination at instance). No WAF attached. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Flask app served via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database at /data/app.db on an EBS volume. No additional middleware or reverse proxy filtering.
